### `POST /cluster/config`

```ts
proxmox.cluster.config.$post()
```

Generate new cluster configuration. If no links given, default to local IP address as link0.

Returns `string`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clustername` | string | yes | The name of the cluster. — format `pve-node`, ≤ 15 chars |
| `link0`…`link7` | string |  | Address and priority information of a single corosync link. (up to 8 links supported; link0..link7) |
| `nodeid` | number |  | Node id for this node. — min 1 |
| `token-coefficient` | number |  | Coefficient used to determine Corosync's token timeout. See the corosync.conf(5) manual for more details. — min 0, default `125` |
| `votes` | number |  | Number of votes for this node. — min 1 |

### `POST /cluster/config/join`

```ts
proxmox.cluster.config.join.$post()
```

Joins this node into an existing cluster. If no links are given, default to IP resolved by node's hostname on single link (fallback fails for clusters with multiple links).

Returns `string`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fingerprint` | string | yes | Certificate SHA 256 fingerprint. |
| `force` | boolean |  | Do not throw error if node already exists. |
| `hostname` | string | yes | Hostname (or IP) of an existing cluster member. |
| `link0`…`link7` | string |  | Address and priority information of a single corosync link. (up to 8 links supported; link0..link7) |
| `nodeid` | number |  | Node id for this node. — min 1 |
| `password` | string | yes | Superuser (root) password of peer node. — ≤ 128 chars |
| `votes` | number |  | Number of votes for this node — min 0 |

### `POST /cluster/config/nodes/{node}`

```ts
proxmox.cluster.config.nodes.$(node).$post()
```

Adds a node to the cluster configuration. This call is for internal use.

Returns `object`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiversion` | number |  | The JOIN_API_VERSION of the new node. |
| `force` | boolean |  | Do not throw error if node already exists. |
| `link0`…`link7` | string |  | Address and priority information of a single corosync link. (up to 8 links supported; link0..link7) |
| `new_node_ip` | string |  | IP Address of node to add. Used as fallback if no links are given. — format `ip` |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |
| `nodeid` | number |  | Node id for this node. — min 1 |
| `votes` | number |  | Number of votes for this node — min 0 |
